content: <div class="content-intro"><p>Acme AI builds reliable AI systems for businesses. A fictional company for the LVLme tests.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2><p>Plan and run the launch of new models to enterprise customers in Asia Pacific, working with research, product and safety teams.</p><h2>Responsibilities</h2><ul><li>Own launch plans from first customer pilot to general release</li><li>Coordinate research, product, safety and sales teams around one timeline</li><li>Report launch risks and progress to senior leaders every week</li></ul><h2>Qualifications</h2><ul><li>6+ years of technical program management</li><li>Experience launching software products to enterprise customers</li><li>Must be a citizen of Australia or New Zealand</li></ul><h2>Nice to have</h2><ul><li>Experience with machine learning products</li></ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Annual salary</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$180,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$220,000 AUD</span></div></div></div>
title: Technical Program Manager, Model Launches
